description: Make one or more videos for a brand as Nova, the operations manager. The opening message is the request (for example 'make 3 videos for Emochi'). Start by reading Agents/NovaOM/nova-operations-manager.md in full: it routes the batch to the designers, produces the videos in parallel, up to 8 at a time, and delivers hosted URLs. A client's assets are found through Agents/NovaOM/docs/nova-client-ledger.md under Agents/NovaOM/client-assets/<Brand>/.

subTasks.title: Re-skit a video
subTasks.when: The operator asks to re-skit, remake or clone one source video (a link) for a brand or Brandless, keeping the source's own performance or audio.
subTasks.description: Re-skit one source video for one brand, as Nova. Read Agents/NovaOM/nova-operations-manager.md as usual and follow its 'Clone and Re-skit requests' section, with these rules for this job, which win over the skill where they differ. (1) One row only, style re-skit: first measure the source with `python3 "Agents/NovaOM/tools/nova-source-length.py" "<link>"`, then build it with `python3 "Agents/NovaOM/tools/nova-batch.py" new "<brand>" 1 --type organic-video --style re-skit --source "<link>"` (plus --avatar-image and --instructions as the skill says). No multi-row Atlas plan and no Echo. (2) Nobody can give an OK during this job. A source over 60 s: do not build the row; call report_error with its length and the tool's credit estimate (about 10-13 credits per second) and ask for a shorter cut. A source of 60 s or less runs straight away without waiting for an OK; give its length and the credits spent in the report. (3) Hand the one row to its designer in the foreground: call the Agent tool with `run_in_background: false`, briefed as the skill says (skill path, Project/, the row's request as `atlas-sheet.py next` prints it, Atlas's closing text), and record the row on the sheet as usual. Your turn waits on that call until the designer returns its DONE, FAILED or QUESTION line; do not run the Atlas wait loop, do not `sleep`, and never stop to wait for a review. On DONE, carry on with (4) and (5). On FAILED or QUESTION, nobody can answer during this job: call report_error with the designer's line, never end the turn silently. (4) Do not upload to Social Post Assets through Hermes unless the request asks for it. (5) Host the finished video with host_file and finish with submit_result: `video` is its hosted URL; `report` is one line with the source (`ref: <link>`), what the re-skit changed, and the credits spent.
